_note: Gzip bytes (Node's zlib.gzipSync, default level); raw is an optional second cap. Each cap is about one and a half times the size measured when it was set, or twice for the data files. Raising one needs a one-line reason in this file.

entry._reason: dist/pogo-figures.js, the one file every page loads, holding no element: 2232 measured 2026-11-16, chunks under assets/; the plan's ceiling is 120000.

eager._reason: The entry and the chunks it imports statically (the engine glue), fetched before any figure nears the screen: 6305 measured 2026-11-16 (the engine chunk now carries src/assets.ts).

largestChunk._reason: Any one JS file but the entry; the largest is the kit (figure, strings, theme, store), shared by every element: 14120 measured 2026-11-16.

total._reason: Every JS file of dist/, what a page holding all seventeen elements fetches: 100684 measured 2026-11-16.
